data.name: Durgadas
data.long_meaning: Durgadas is a compound name composed of two words - 'Durga' and 'Das'. Durga is a feminine form of the goddess Shakti, symbolizing strength, courage, and protection. Das is a masculine suffix that translates to 'servant' or 'slave'. Together, Durgadas represents a valiant warrior who serves and protects.
